name: Rising
audio: deep ice cracking, a low wind and a cold crystalline chime; no speech
world: The polar sea is alive: ice shards fall, snow and diamond dust drift, a whale breaches, seals slide off the floes, snowy owls circle and arctic foxes bound across the ice.

actions.beat: The ice shelf groans and cracks outward in every direction as shards lift and fall, a whale breaching in the open water between the floes.
{{She}} rises slowly and deliberately through the broken ice on a pillar of frozen water, arms lowered, palms turned down as if holding the ice steady.
Frost spreads across the water around {{her}} and diamond dust falls as {{her}} eyes ignite with {{MAGIC}} light; {{she}} lifts {{her}} chin and meets the camera, calm and commanding.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
